plans.objective: B** — it is the most *information-dense under uncertainty*. Even if A is true, the probe (≤6 requests) costs essentially nothing and is honest; if B or C is true, I get usable data and a genuine analysis. Crucially, B forces me to **explicitly record per-URL error classes**, which directly satisfies hard constraint 2 ("下载失败必须如实记录失败的 URL 与错误信息"). Choosing B rather than C guards against the most dangerous failure mode here: **silently substituting synthetic data when the download fails**, which the verification criteria treat as categorical failure.

steps.description: 这是一个"自选课题、公开数据、完整研究"的任务，不属于 DFT/MD/PDE 等数值模拟，因此用 explore 模式：先在多个可达的公开 CSV 源中并行探测（验证硬约束 1：真实下载 + sha256 + 行列数 + ≤5MB），选出数据结构最清晰、研究问题最可证伪的一个；然后按缺失项清单逐轮推进——下载凭证 → 研究问题形式化 → EDA 与清洗 → 主统计检验 → 假设诊断/稳健性 → 结论与局限 → 可重跑脚本。本轮先做数据源探测与下载凭证生成，记录失败 URL 与错误类（满足硬约束 2）。
